description: This script performs custom object detection using the ImageAI library with a YOLOv3 model, processing an input image to detect bicycles and backpacks, and saving the output image with detections.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsYOLOv3
methods.description: Configures the detection model to use YOLOv3 architecture.

methods.name: setModelPath
methods.description: Sets the file path to the pre-trained model weights.

methods.name: loadModel
methods.description: Loads the model into memory for detection.

methods.name: CustomObjects
methods.description: Creates a custom object detection configuration specifying which objects to detect.

methods.name: detectCustomObjectsFromImage
methods.description: Performs detection on a specified input image and outputs the results.
